description_en: Queries retrievable devices by device ID, user nickname, user ID, or device attributes
description_zh: 按设备ID、用户昵称、用户ID或设备属性查询可回捞设备
name: GetTlogDeviceList

parameters.help_en:
The OS type. Valid values:
iphoneos (iOS)
android (Android)
parameters.help_zh:
os类型
iphoneos(苹果)
android(安卓)
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The device ID. This parameter is deprecated
parameters.name: utdid

parameters.help_en: The start of the device active time range. Unit: milliseconds (Unix timestamp)
parameters.help_zh: 设备活跃时间开始，Unix 毫秒
parameters.name: begin_date

parameters.help_en: The end of the device active time range. Unit: milliseconds (Unix timestamp)
parameters.help_zh: 设备活跃时间结束，Unix 毫秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The general exact query keyword. The value is used to query deviceId, userNick, and userId simultaneously, and is mutually exclusive with dimensions such as brand, version, and model
parameters.help_zh: 通用精确查询；代码会同时作为 deviceId/userNick/userId 查询，且与品牌、版本、机型等维度互斥
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The device model filter. This parameter is mapped to deviceModel
parameters.help_zh: 设备机型筛选，映射到 deviceModel
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The region filter. This parameter is mapped to geo
parameters.name: city

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This is the primary code, which usually indicates a network or non-business error
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误Code，主Code，一般为网络或非业务错误

items.description_en:
The device information.
appVersion String: the application version number.
os String: the device operating system name or platform identifier.
ip String: the device client IP address.
updateTime Long: the device information update time, in milliseconds (Unix timestamp).
userName String: the device user nickname or username.
deviceId String: the unique device identifier.
userId String: the business-side user ID.
clientTime Long: the device client time, in milliseconds (Unix timestamp).
geo String: the device geographical information, typically in the format of country-province-city.
osVersion String: the operating system version.
conType Integer: the connection type. Valid values: 0 (unknown), 1 (in-app persistent connection or main process persistent connection), and 2 (silent persistent connection or non-main process persistent connection. In this state, logs may fail to be pulled).
appId String: the unique application identifier, typically in the format of <AppKey>@<Os>.
online Boolean: indicates whether the device is online.
appKey String: the application AppKey.
serverTime Long: the time when the server recorded the device information, in milliseconds (Unix timestamp).
deviceModel String: the device model.
brand String: the device brand
items.description_zh:
设备信息数据
appVersion String 应用版本号
os String 设备操作系统名称或平台标识
ip String 设备客户端 IP 地址
updateTime Long 设备信息更新时间，毫秒时间戳
userName String 设备用户昵称/用户名
deviceId String 设备唯一标识
userId String 业务侧用户 ID
clientTime Long 设备客户端时间，毫秒时间戳
geo String 设备地域信息，通常格式为国家-省份-城市
osVersion String 操作系统版本
conType Integer 连接类型，0 表示未知，1 表示应用内长连接/主进程长连接，2 表示静默长连接/非主进程长连接，此状态下可能无法正常拉取日志
appId String 应用唯一标识，通常格式为 <AppKey>@<Os>
online Boolean 设备是否在线
appKey String 应用 AppKey
serverTime Long 服务端记录设备信息的时间，毫秒时间戳
deviceModel String 设备型号
brand String 设备品牌
